name: list_calendars
summary: List the names of the calendars configured in Calendar.app. Use this first to discover the exact calendar name to target when adding or querying events.

name: query_events
summary: List events across your calendars within a date range (e.g. what's coming up this week). Returns each event's uid — pass that uid to modify_event or delete_event. Note: querying Calendar.app can take a few seconds when you have many events.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range to search, in YYYY-MM-DD form (inclusive).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day of the range to search, in YYYY-MM-DD form (inclusive, whole day). Defaults to start_date (a single-day query).

params.name: calendar
params.description: Restrict the search to a single calendar by exact name (from list_calendars). Omit to search all calendars.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: add_event
summary: Create a calendar event. STAGED for confirmation before it is created; undo deletes the created event.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar to add the event to (from list_calendars).

params.name: title
params.description: Event title / summary.

params.name: date
params.description: Day of the event, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start time on that day, in 24-hour HH:MM form.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End time on that day, in 24-hour HH:MM form; must be later than start_time.

params.name: location
params.description: Optional location for the event.

params.name: notes
params.description: Optional notes / description for the event.

name: modify_event
summary: Change an existing event identified by its uid (from query_events). Supply the full new title/date/start_time/end_time (the event is rescheduled to exactly these); location and notes are changed only if provided. STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the prior values.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar the event lives in (from query_events).

params.name: uid
params.description: The event's uid, as returned by query_events.

params.name: title
params.description: New event title / summary (supply the current one unchanged if you only mean to change the time).

params.name: date
params.description: New day for the event, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

params.name: start_time
params.description: New start time, in 24-hour HH:MM form.

params.name: end_time
params.description: New end time, in 24-hour HH:MM form; must be later than start_time.

params.name: location
params.description: If provided, replaces the event's location. If omitted, the existing location is left unchanged.

params.name: notes
params.description: If provided, replaces the event's notes/description. If omitted, the existing notes are left unchanged.

name: delete_event
summary: Delete an event identified by its uid (from query_events). STAGED for confirmation; undo re-creates the event from the details captured before deletion.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar the event lives in (from query_events).

params.name: uid
params.description: The event's uid, as returned by query_events.
